---
applyTo: 'messages/*.json,i18n/**/*.ts'
excludeAgent: 'coding-agent'
---

## Message files (messages/en.json, es.json, pt.json)

Verify language correctness and semantic equivalence across locales: spelling, accents,
terminology, punctuation, ICU syntax and variables, plural context, copied untranslated
text and meaningful key use. Do not require a mechanically identical JSON shape when
locale-specific grammar needs a different expression.

## i18n/\*_/_.ts

Review locale resolution, fallback, namespace use, localized date/number formats and
locale-aware navigation. Do not allow fallback behavior to silently expose
wrong-language, unescaped or inaccessible user-facing content.
